require 'csv'
require 'bigdecimal'

# Returns up to five CSV::Row objects, highest numeric value first.
def top_rows(path, column)
  table = CSV.read(path, headers: true)
  column = column.to_s
  raise ArgumentError, "Unknown CSV column: #{column}" unless table.headers.include?(column)

  table.sort_by { |row| -BigDecimal(row[column].to_s) }.first(5)
end
